        }
        .bg-glow-layer {
            position: absolute; width: 800px; height: 800px; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(150px); pointer-events: none; animation: pulse-glow 15s infinite ease-in-out;

        /* Scanline effect */

            content: " ";
            display: block;
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            right: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(rgba(18, 16, 16, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.06), rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.02), rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.06));

            background-size: 100% 2px, 3px 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.3;
